contractionCapacityRatio.rationale: Exogenous ZANO reserve USD / circulating fUSD, where circulating = minted 11,400,000 − reserve-held 4,000,001 = 7,399,999; 11115334.03 / 7399999 = 1.502072, matching the issuer-displayed 1.50x coverage ratio on the homepage. contractionCapacity.basis: Homepage shows 1.50x ZANO coverage of circulating fUSD and white paper describes overcollateralized ZANO reserve with market-maker bots defending $1 on the Zano DEX. Limited: reserve ZANO balance is not independently re-measured on-chain in this review (confidential amounts; view-only seed requires wallet software), and contraction is market-bot / off-chain policy rather than a contract-enforced redeem rail.

confidenceAndIncentives.basis: White paper: decentralized market-maker bots place standing buy/sell orders near $1; anyone may run the open-source bot. Dual-source: white paper §§4–10 + homepage coverage/reserve panel. Limited: bot operators, inventory funding, and order depth are not independently enumerated.
